title: What calculating engines cost the British Treasury, against a locomotive of the day
description: Bar chart, pounds sterling. Difference Engine No. 1, by the final payment to Joseph Clement in August 1834: £17,478. The locomotive John Bull, built by Robert Stephenson and Company in 1831: £784. The price Edvard Scheutz asked in 1857 for a copy of the Swedish engine: £1,200. Data: Swade, Calculation and Tabulation in the Nineteenth Century (2003).
heading: POUNDS STERLING · 1831–1857
